tasks.description: Compute heat index (Rothfusz/Steadman approximation adapted for Celsius) from temperature_c and humidity_percent; output per-reading index and classify risk bands (e.g., Caution, Extreme).
Compute saturation vapor pressure es (kPa) via Tetens from temperature_c, actual vapor pressure ea = es*(RH/100), and VPD = es - ea; flag dryness/humidity risk levels.
Estimate wet-bulb temperature (°C) using Stull’s 2011 approximation from temperature_c and humidity_percent; return Tw and T–Tw spread as a ventilation/cooling cue.
Count minutes inside/outside a configurable comfort envelope (e.g., 22–26°C and 30–60% RH) per hour and overall; return totals and percent time comfortable.
Validate readings against metadata ranges; detect out-of-range values, duplicate timestamps, and missing 5-minute intervals; report issues and optionally clip or forward-fill.
Compute rolling Pearson correlation between temperature_c and humidity_percent over the last N readings (e.g., N=12) to gauge coupling; classify as strong/weak/neutral.
Aggregate readings into hourly bins; compute mean, min, max, and sample count for temperature_c and humidity_percent; handle partial hours.
Flag sudden spikes using absolute 5-minute deltas exceeding configurable thresholds (e.g., temp > 0.8°C, RH > 3%); return indices with pre/post values.
Compute dew point temperature (°C) from temperature_c and humidity_percent using the Magnus–Tetens approximation; also output dew point depression (T − Td).
Compute absolute humidity (g/m³) from temperature_c and humidity_percent via vapor pressure; include optional short-window rolling mean for smoothing.
Estimate moist air specific enthalpy (kJ/kg dry air) assuming sea-level pressure using mixing ratio from RH; output enthalpy and its 5-minute change rate.
Accumulate degree-minutes beyond a comfort band (e.g., T>26°C or RH>60%); quantify exposure as magnitude × time per hour and total.
Generate on/off alerts when temperature or humidity cross thresholds with configurable hysteresis margins and minimum dwell times to avoid alert chatter.
Forecast the next 12 readings (next hour at 5-minute steps) for temperature and humidity using exponential smoothing (EWMA) with configurable alpha.
Compute rolling standard deviation over a short window (e.g., N=6) for temperature_c and humidity_percent; flag intervals of elevated variability.

Fit a simple linear regression over the last N readings (e.g., N=6) to estimate slope (per hour) for temperature_c and humidity_percent; classify trends as rising/stable/falling using small configurable slope thresholds.

Apply a two-sided CUSUM on temperature_c and humidity_percent to detect sustained mean shifts; return change points with direction, start/end indices, and estimated shift magnitude; parameters k and h configurable.

Compute autocorrelation at small lags (e.g., 2–6 samples = 10–30 minutes) for temperature_c to identify oscillatory HVAC cycling; report dominant lag period if correlation exceeds a threshold; optionally evaluate humidity_percent.

Estimate mold risk by accumulating minutes where RH ≥ 65% and dew point depression (T − Td) ≤ 2–3°C (Td via Magnus); output rolling/daily risk score and flag when exposure exceeds configurable durations.
Compute water vapor mixing ratio (g/kg dry air) from temperature_c and humidity_percent assuming sea-level pressure; return per-reading values and an optional short-window rolling mean.
Use sensor accuracy (±0.2°C, ±2% RH) to compute lower/upper bounds for each reading; indicate definite vs possible comfort threshold violations by comparing uncertainty bands to configured limits.
